verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an AI Game Agent and an editor, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Phaser acting as an MCP server that other clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Copilot connect to. Nothing shows Phaser, its editor or its Game Agent connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-role evidence cannot be credited for this client-side story.
